//: LM Studio as a local lane — point CLI_BRIDGE_LANES_FILE at this file (or merge it).
//1: ban-safe like every lane: cli-bridge just spawns the `lms` CLI; no keys, no network.
//2: `lms chat <model> -p <prompt> -y` prints the answer to stdout and quits (-y skips the
//3: interactive prompt). The model is POSITIONAL, so set it in default_model below or via
//4: CLI_BRIDGE_LMSTUDIO_MODEL=<id> — replace the example with a CHAT model you've pulled
//5: (`lms get <model>`; an embedding-only install has nothing to chat with).
//6: First call may print 'Waking up LM Studio service…' while the runtime starts.
//7: JURY CAVEAT: a local runtime of open weights correlates with OTHER local runtimes of
//8: the same weights (ollama, mlx, llama.cpp) — real jury decorrelation comes from distinct
//9: VENDORS, not a second runtime of the same model. Use this for $0/offline, not diversity.
install_hint: https://lmstudio.ai — then `lms get <chat-model>` to pull a chat model
note: Local via LM Studio (`lms chat -p`). $0, private, offline. Read-only. Set the model in default_model or CLI_BRIDGE_LMSTUDIO_MODEL. Local open weights → correlated with other local runtimes; not jury diversity.
